gates.name: Repository Integrity
gates.evidence: Working tree pristine; reference repositories (Agent Chess, Meta-Graph-Codebase-Navigator) untouched.

gates.name: Backend Quality
gates.evidence: 31/31 Pytest unit, integration, and adversarial tests passed in 57.42s.

gates.name: Frontend Quality
gates.evidence: Vite production bundle compiled 1,935 modules in 8.75s with 0 TypeScript or linting errors.

gates.name: Workflow Authorization
gates.evidence: WRK-01 (unapproved ticket rejection) and WRK-02 (non-passing merge rejection) validated; candidate drift blocks merge.

gates.name: Patch Integrity & Boundary Enforcement
gates.evidence: SEC-01 (diff deletion headers) and SEC-02 (direct hunk path traversal) blocked; AST security visitor detects prohibited primitives.

gates.name: Execution Isolation
gates.evidence: Docker daemon offline on host. Safe fail-closed policy verified: PytestRunner returns exit_code=1, command=BLOCKED without executing on host.

gates.name: Workflow Correctness
gates.evidence: Complete 13-step lifecycle verified end-to-end on disposable repository via demonstrate_complete_workflow.py.

gates.name: Recovery & Concurrency
gates.evidence: REL-01 (merge conflict rollback via git merge --abort), REL-02 (Windows taskkill /F /T), _merge_lock serialization, duplicate run 409 Conflict, and startup reconciliation verified.

gates.name: Evaluation Integrity
gates.evidence: MetricsCalculator computes honest metrics from database; versioned Benchmark Suite v1.0 executed; JSON export verified.

gates.name: Provider Reliability
gates.evidence: ModelRouter strictly enforces user consent and fallback boundaries; offline mock fallback verified.

gates.name: Privacy & Telemetry
gates.evidence: Zero API key leakage; regex masks keys to gsk_...Uctb in logs and Phoenix traces.

gates.name: Clean Installation
gates.evidence: Documented setup scripts (start.ps1, stop.ps1, verify_acceptance.py) verified on local environment.

gates.name: Documentation Completeness
gates.evidence: Complete specification documents created across all 4 phases including architecture, state machine, repair lifecycle, metrics reference, and runbooks.

gates.name: Reproducibility
gates.evidence: All verification scripts (demonstrate_complete_workflow.py, run_benchmarks.py, verify_acceptance.py) execute deterministically with exit code 0.
